actual.titulo: Mother, May I Murder • Nine Bullet "Suicide"
actual.descripcion: Nine Bullet "Suicide" | Police reveal a suspected suicide as a brutal nine-shot execution with only two suspects, the victim's ex-wife and their son; that son, Radley Horwitz, recalls the toxic series of events, which he says triggered his mother's murderous act of rage.

siguiente.titulo: Mother, May I Murder • The Grifter Murders
siguiente.descripcion: The Grifter Murders | The mysterious disappearance of a New York millionaire and an audacious plan to steal an $8 million townhouse unearths a scarcely believable story; how glamorous mother and son, Sante and Kenny Kimes, con, cheat and kill their way across America.

lista.titulo: Lethally Blonde • Too Fast Too Furious
lista.descripcion: Too Fast Too Furious | When detectives respond to a 911 call from a lavish Miami apartment, they uncover a bloody scene with a popular social media influencer at the center; as they piece events together, soon it gets clear that a lot is going on behind closed doors.

Hollywood Thriller | In the 1970s, Anneka Di Lorenzo finds fame as a successful model in Penthouse Magazine and secures a part in the movie "Caligula"; however, her life eventually unravels with tragic consequences.

A Model Murder | An aspiring model, Kimberly Pandelios, accepts an offer to pose in lingerie for a mysterious photographer, then disappears; years later, a young woman contacts the police when she begins to suspect that her boyfriend may have been the killer.

lista.titulo: Lethally Blonde • The Fall of Aubrey Gold
lista.descripcion: The Fall of Aubrey Gold | A missing person's report sends investigators on a desperate search through the seedy underbelly of the Floribama panhandle; all roads lead to a once sought-after porn star, whose fate is revealed when an informant comes forward to unearth the truth.

The Depraved Heart | Elizabeth meets with the Harris family to investigate the tragic loss of their beloved daughter, and sister, Sarah; what was supposed to be a routine dental visit for Sarah turned into a toxic and dangerous relationship with a well-respected surgeon.

Sleeping With a Stranger | Elizabeth Chambers unravels the deception and manipulation that leads to the bloody ending of Kelly Sutcliffe's marriage, but a vicious attack is only the start of Kelly's nightmare; living in fear, Kelly turns to an unlikely source for protection.

Three's a Crowd | Elizabeth untangles the web of lies that wrongfully imprisoned Michelle Hadley for 88 grueling days; Michelle finally gets to take back her power and her voice as she reveals the twisted truth behind the frame job by her demented ex.
Don't Shoot Mommy | Elizabeth investigates the troubling case of Kate Ranta, a military wife who found herself in an abusive relationship and battling all the systems that protect abusers.

Estreno ║ Alienated | Rod McCall marries a whip-smart former police officer and builds a family he believes in; when that love curdles into betrayal, his wife doesn't just leave; she dismantles his life piece by piece; he fights to survive it, but the worst comes later.

lista.titulo: What Happened in the Haight House?
lista.descripcion: Estreno ║ For nearly two decades, Tausha Haight endures emotional and psychological abuse from her seemingly perfect husband, Michael, who hides a darker reality; when she fights to leave, escalating red flags put Tausha and her five children in danger.

lista.titulo: 48 Hours • Could Angela Prichard Have Been Saved?
lista.descripcion: Could Angela Prichard Have Been Saved? | When Angela Prichard was terrorized by her husband, she turned to the police for help, but it did not prevent her death.

Angel of Death | In 1996, Larry Schlegel visits his elderly mother at the hospital one last time before she succumbs to pneumonia; years later, police inform Schlegel that his mother's death was not at all what it seemed.

Mistress Roulette | Married family man Dr. Adam Frasch has a booming practice, and he loves to spend money on houses, automobiles and exotic dancers; ultimately, the doctor will reap what he sows in deceit and jealousy.

Accident Waiting to Happen | Single mother Rainey Morin meets soul mate Robert Kowalski who treats her like a queen; however, beneath Kowalski's kind veneer is a dark history that threatens to wreak havoc.
Who Lies Beneath | Valuing wealth more than love, Michelle Donohue casts aside good men before meeting Mr. Right who gives her a taste of her own medicine and sends her down a murderous path.
